notes.title: Patch note 2025.8.19
notes.notes:
This update contains the following fixes and adjustments: 

Fixes


 Fixed an issue with the text in the Hero Mode results screen.
 Fixed an issue where the reward for getting first place in the arcade couldn't be claimed.
 Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where some items would result in a permanent shield.
 Fixed an issue with the Jeweled Branch's description to better match its actual effect.
 Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where a certain contract only affected one round.
 Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where a certain contract's effects wasn't able to end normally.
 Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where closing the game immediately after returning to the main menu from a battle would cause the battle to start over when it is resumed.
 Fixed an issue where having the Hero of Ice badge and Third Eye Figurine equipped at the same time would result in doubled shields.
 Fixed an issue where restarting the first elevator fight in the Rose Idol DLC could mess up the game's logic.
 Fixed the logic of the buttons in the Navigation Terminal's tutorial.
 Fixed items being unlocked earlier than they should be due to multiple save files.


Thanks to everyone who reported bugs to us. We will continue fixing the various issues in the game. If you encounter any problems during gameplay, you can get in touch with us below!

notes.title: Summer Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
The hot sun beating down from above signifies the arrival of summer!
Time to sit down and play with Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy's latest update!

We've recently given our community discord a makeover, given the entire server a brand new look.If you're interested in Touhou, feel free to come and chat with us there!
(We also share the latest news about development there from time to time)

→ Click here to join our Discord ←

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/60523e20a8d5cff8504e184073de4070d6e01c3f.png
=========================================

This update adds new content to both Story Mode and Roguelike Mode!

★ Story Mode ★

● New Overloading mechanic: the hero is finally capable of bringing spell cards and items past her maximum cost!
(Overloading is limited to 2 points. The more overloaded the hero is, the higher the chance of her taking twice the damage when hit!)
(This feature is only available after successfully defeating the Nightmare Miko)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/2025a93bfe2a3eac235a13ef98f5527ff1a32923.png
● Increased the number of Item slots and Badge slots, allowing for more varied builds and to leverage the new overloading mechanic.
(The fifth item slot is only available after successfully defeating the Nightmare Miko)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/d33943feac6dec75b9beecbea4dfa844f592e26c.png
★ Roguelite Mode ★

● Added Perfumes: you can sink your Purple Coins into temporary buffs!
(In the Roguelite lobby, you can spend Purple Coins to obtain various buffs that last for one run)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/e98c499d57449c0cdb229588b5ab850888344176.png
● New Contract Booth amenity: take on curses in exchange for powerful buffs. Do you dare face the challenge?
(During the course of an adventure, the hero will encounter dark purple Contract Booths where she can willingly take on curses in exchange for a powerful buff that lasts for one adventure)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/b9d60c07b383c45baba068eddd3b15f3b3632570.png
Aside from what's listed above, we've also made major improvements to many aspects of the game which you're welcome to check out!

★ Lastly... ★

We have one more piece of good news: 

Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy will be released on Nintendo Switch in 2026!
(Switch 1 will get priority. We have plans to release physical copies, too)
(It's uncertain whether or not we'll get it onto the Switch 2, but we'll try to make it happen)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/6cd8dd575d4bdead459229210c528029675e1c06.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/0eb4c5100fd5dbaa727051a33eb03c2aeebf9b6f.gif

notes.title: First DLC will release on April 3!
notes.notes:
★The Show Is About To Begin!★

The wait is over! Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy's very first combat-oriented DLC—Rose Idol—is slated for release on April 3!

We're in the final stages of development for DLC1, and any remaining time will be used to polish/improve the game. Please be patient for a little bit longer! (We're working on it! Promise!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3213970/DLC1/

DLC1 will be priced at 2.49 USD and includes the following content:

A much anticipated character
Two exhilarating battles
Three exquisite songs
Four exciting spell cards and items

The soundtrack for this DLC will be as its own separate OST, priced at 1.99 USD.

This OST contains 15 new songs. A lot of effort has been put into making these songs sound the best they can, so if you're interested in idols, remember to pick up the OST!

Additionally, unlike the songs from the base game, this OST will include a Seamless Version containing all the songs in DLC1 (a 21 minutes long song), giving you the true live concert experience! If that sounds like something you're interesting in, please give it a listen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/836e642474e50a296f41669ae390e40efccf67d6.png

April 3 also happens to be the one year anniversary of Hero of Ice Fairy's full release, so we would like to thank everyone for their continued support of HoIF!

Our plan is to continue our efforts and make the game even better. We hope to bring you even more, even better content in the future!

The stage of the Rose Idol. Her performance awaits!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/0eb4c5100fd5dbaa727051a33eb03c2aeebf9b6f.gif

notes.title: Patch note 2024.12.18
notes.notes:
This update contains the following fixes and adjustments: 

This update adds 4 brand new amenities: 

  First-Aid Station: gives a random number of HP shards.
  Locked Chest: a chest that requires a special key to open. Opening it gives an item.
  Coin Chest: a chest that requires 4 Purple Coins to open. Opening it gives an item.
  Luck Chest: a chest that requires 5 Gold Coins per attempt. If you win a prize, you get an item.
These new amenities will randomly appear on the right-most area of each safe floor!

Other additions

  ⑨ new items for Hero Mode：Anchor, Ibaraki Box Green Bunny Pill, Bunny Medkit, Ice, Maneki-Neko's Bell, Red Stone Cherry、Cursed Ribbon & Mysterious Key.
  Added the spell card "Dream Diary" from the main story into Hero Mode.
  When entering Hero Mode from the main menu, a popup will now ask the player if they want to continue their last adventure if it is not yet completed.

Improvements

  Improved the user experience of the item recycling screen and adjusted the weight of some amenities' chances to appear.
  In Hero Mode, if the player already has certain classes of items, other items of the same class will have a slightly higher chance of appearing (does not always appear)
  In Hero Mode, the Recycling Station can now recycle two items.
  In Hero Mode, the Bunny Bank's minimum deposit has been lowered from 50 coins to 30 coins. Its point redemption requirement has also been lowered from 40 points to 30 points. Redeeming points also now adds 20 Bunny Coins into your account free of charge.

Fixes

  Fixed some minor stability issues.


Thanks to everyone who reported bugs to us. We will continue fixing the various issues in the game. If you encounter any problems during gameplay, you can get in touch with us below!

Email: 728434587@qq.com

notes.title: Collection of English patch notes
notes.notes:
We've compiled the English version of the previous two patch notes together so you don't miss out on the content of two updates!


Additions

  Added a new Hero Mode exclusive item: Celestial's Peach.
  Added opening to Hero Mode (only one section has been added. Later sections will be added in subsequent updates).
  Added a popup to notify the player when two conflicting challenges are selected.
  Added tutorials for the Bunny Shop, Backpack Upgrades and Difficulty Selection in Hero Mode.
  Added a yellow outline to Amenities. Players can now clearly see which items are interactable in the hotel.

Improvements

  Improved survival phases in boss battles. The length of all survival phases in boss battles have been decreased by 30%~40%.
  Improved the VFX of Bat Hairclip and Unstable Launcher: their projectiles will no longer overlap.
  Restricted where Fatal Laser and Pursuing Spirit can show up in Hero Mode, preventing stages from getting too difficult;
  Increased the interaction delay when opening the shop in Hero Mode, preventing accidental purchases.
  Improved the reward selection UI. Players can now clearly see which reward they've chosen.
  Improved the effect of the Serving Cart. Interacting with it at max health will now give Bunny Coins instead of health.

Adjustments

  Max health in Hero Mode has been increased from 9 to 18.
  Frost Cannonball now triggers Mimi's and Magician's Broom's collision damage in Hero Mode.
  Energy Drink has been revamped. It immediately raises courage level by one and increases uses of all spell cards in the backpack by one.
  Lunatic Torch no longer makes you take an additional damage.
  Slightly buffed Youkai Lantern, Gourmet's Hitaikakushi and Fireworks(Hero Mode only)
  Sword of Hisou's rarity has been changed to "treasured" (the rarest) and its effect has been slightly increased.
  Sake Sparrow's rarity has been changed to "normal" (the least rarest)
  Slightly nerfed Ice Fang, Glacier Shield, Extreme Snowstorm, Airdrop and Quickfreeze Bubbles(Hero Mode only)

Fixes

  Fixed an issue where controller vibration would disappear.
  Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where locked items in the Bunny Shop would be carried into the next adventure.
  Fixed an issue in Hero Mode with wrong controller button labels;
  Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where the shop would have the wrong number of items after refreshing;
  Fixed an issue where the Energy Drink item would cause courage level to go around curse restrictions;
  Fixed some minor stability issues.
  Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where the game would crash when interacting with the Post Box.
  Fixed an issue in Hero Mode where the amount of items in the Bunny Shop would be scrambled.
  Fixed a few issues with stability.
  Fixed errors in the English version.

notes.title: Patch note 2024.12.3
Major Update! Roguelite Mode public beta!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GDtPDBw4NjM;full][/previewyoutube]
★Roguelite Mode★
It's been a long time coming, but the new free update of Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—Hero Mode—is now in public beta! Experience the fun of a HoIF roguelite for youself!
(This beta is available for all players—no registration needed. You can try out the gamemode once the game updates.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/2025a93bfe2a3eac235a13ef98f5527ff1a32923.png
● Thrilling Boss Rush
In Hero Mode, you'll be fighting every boss that has appeared in the game one more time. If you lose a battle, you fail the challenge!

● Resting Area
When a battle ends, you'll be able to return to a safe resting area. Each area will have various random amenities. Interacting with them will have different effects!
(For example, the food cart, pictured above, allows you to regain health, while the television allows you to take part in a trivia contest)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/f2a6d9aeb66622cb9b3df534066703d693693391.png● New Currency
For the first time ever, the game now has a shop and currency system. Every time a boss is defeated, you'll be awarded Gold Coinsbased on your performance in the battle. These coins can be used in resting areas to buy brand new items and spell cards!

● Tons of New Items
We've added more than 20 new items for Hero Mode, allowing you to try out different builds and synergies during the course of your adventure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/b4ada431665213a579a3069f88776574e8f3ee39.png● Additionally...
Hero Mode also includes random events that appear during battle, toggleable challenges, taking items into a new adventure, and much more for you to discover!

● Final Words
Hero Mode is our first time making a roguelite gamemode, therefore, you may find that some parts of the design aren't really be up to scratch through the course of the game.
However, rest assured, we'll be here to address any flaws or imbalances, as we plan on providing long-term support for Hero Mode.
(Hero Mode and all its updates will be completely free)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/47cd0f9e4b24b4bdfdf30a3700e66df29bf39940.png
If you encounter any bugs, or have any suggestions to improve the game, please email us at 728434587@qq.com or join the game's Discord, or contact us via any other means, and help us make the game as best as it can be!

→Join our Discord←

Hero of Ice Fairy wouldn't be here without the continued support of all players. 
We can't thank you guys enough!!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/0eb4c5100fd5dbaa727051a33eb03c2aeebf9b6f.gif

notes.title: Delay Notice / New release date is April 3
notes.notes:
Our deepest apologies!!!

The full version of Hero of Ice Fairy which was originally planned to release on March 15 will be delayed to April 3.

The reasons for this delay are as follows:
1. As development of the full version continued, we just kept wanting to add more and more things. In order to ensure all the content we want to add into the game can be developed fully and completely, we've decided to dedicate more time to polish. We hope to deliver the full game with as much polish as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/1a73564f264ed5628d3953e4477cd15fc21e2e3c.png

New Content!
We will be adding an all-new Badge system on March 15. As per the image, they function similarly to items; each badge has a unique effect, and all players will be able to experience this update for free!

How to unlock badges:
1. Complete any one challenge stage
2. Talk to Reisen, who should have an exclamation mark above her head, inside the Bunny train. After the cutscene, the badge system will be unlocked.
(If you already have at least one challenge stage completed, you can directly talk to Reisen in the train.) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/3b726d774d08a54f920986a21f15716a8f260111.png

notes.title: New Features, Improvements  Patch Update 2023.10.28
notes.notes:
All content in the major update has been fully translated into English.

This update contains the following fixes and adjustments: 

Fixes

 [Fixed] A bug where the Shopkeeper's Glasses causes bosses to not be able to dash properly;
 [Fixed] A bug where the Unstable Launcher would sometimes fire extra shots;
 [Fixed] A bug where you could equip items exceeding the power limit via spamming;
 [Fixed] A bug with the save screen selection effects;

Additions

 [New] Players can now select a default song in the phonograph. The default song will play whenever the player returns to the train;
 [New] Players can now click on the character illustrations in the catalog to view the full illustration;

Improvements

 [Improvement] During battle, players can now enter the loadout configuration screen from the pause menu. Players no longer need to head back to the train to change their loadout; 
 [Improvement] Players can now toggle help mode on/off at any time in the pause menu.
 [Improvement] Locked stages will now appear in the Navigation Terminal;
 [Improvement] In the loadout configuration screen, a dialog will pop up whenever the player's power limit increases or when they unlock a new item slot.
 [Improvement] After the player completes story stage 4, the conductor will remind players on what to do in order to continue the game.

Adjustments

 Slightly decreased the difficulty of story stage 5, story stage 6, In Arrears and Unconventional News;

 Absolute Zero — Slightly decreased full screen damage; slightly decreased cooldown time; courage cost lowered from 2 to 1.
 Extreme Snowstorm — Massively decreased hailstone damage; slightly decreased cooldown time; courage cost lowered from 3 to 2.
 Frost Cannonball — Bounces lowered by 1.

 Secret Manual — Slightly increased attack range.
 Shopkeeper's Glasses — Slightly increased damage; slightly decreased spread angle.
 Hero's Emblem — Slightly decreased projectile's homing strength.
 Icy-Hakkero — Each's level's laser is now easier to differentiate.

 Unstable Launcher — Massively increased damage; increased amount of missiles fired under different circumstances; effect can also be activated while using the shield.
 Lucky Carrot — Slightly increased the chance of not losing courage levels when hit.
 Magician's Broom — Slightly increased collision damage.
 Bunny Ears — Slightly increased strength of slowdown effect; slightly decreased effect range.
 Ibuki Gourd (S) — Slightly increased the player's hurtbox.
 Mini Moon — Slightly decreased bullet dispel range.
 Floating Taiko — Slightly decreased bullet dispel range.

We sincerely appreciate everyone's bug reports. We'll continue to address various issues in the game. If you encounter any problems during gameplay, please feel free to provide us your feedback!

notes.title: 18,000 Copies sold! English Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Since its release in February 25, our game—Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—has managed to break 18k sales in just one month !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/8bdf20abf5ee9fd445a43d5135a0654ced1cb7cc.png

This comes as a big shock to us since it wildly surpassed our original expectations. Back in early 2021, I decided to make a no micro-dodging game out of spite since I was suffering from Touhou Hidden Star in Four Seasons's unique problem of not being able to properly see the bullets. I honestly never thought our game'd achieve such results two years down the line. It's thanks to everyone's continued support that we could get to this point. 

Without everyone, we—and by extension Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—wouldn't be where we are today, and for that we couldn't thank you enough!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/a96454a6e7f013b44c134a45c6286aba8406918e.png

English Version Coming Soon
Currently, we're dedicating our time to finishing the game's English version, with a release slated for April 12. If you're interested in helping us test the English version, please join our Discord server. The first round of testing will commence on the first week of April.

→Click here to join our Discord server←

Furthermore, in April we'll also be releasing a feature to replay past story events as well as a mode for players who aren't great at action games, in addition to some new items and spell cards.

We understand that there are high expectations for what comes next in the game, and we promise we'll do our best to give everyone the full Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy experience!
